cruiserScores._note: Vacation Genie only. What cruisers say about each ship per category (table ship_cruiser_scores), worth points to a traveler who cares about that thing. strength = matcher points per full rating point above or below the fleet on the things the traveler cares about, averaged across them (0 switches it off). halfTrustReviews = the review count at which one site's reading counts for half. oneSiteShare = how much of its lead or deficit a ship keeps when only one site really knows it (Mark 11/25, after sailing Islander: 'dial down margaritaville'; 1 = no discount). counts = which cruiser topic answers for which virtue. Method: server/src/lib/ship-scores.ts. DRAFT for Mark's correction.

firsthand._note: Mark's FIRSTHAND verdicts per ship per topic. Each REPLACES what reviewers scored for that ship and that topic. standing = rating points above (+) or below (-) the fleet average; for scale, the best-reviewed food in the fleet stands at about +0.55 and the worst at about -0.6. Topics: dining, service, entertainment, things_to_do, kids, value, cabins, ship. Always carry the why. The standing numbers are Claude's reading of Mark's words, for his correction.
